Effective October 7, 2026

Privacy policy

ProcessAlpha is designed as a local-first decision journal. This page explains what data the product handles and why.

Data you provide

Trade symbols, prices, theses, invalidation conditions, process checks, rulebook entries, and an email address when you choose cloud sync. Do not enter exchange credentials, wallet keys, or other secrets.

Local and cloud storage

Journal records are stored in your browser. If you sign in for cloud sync, journal records are also stored in a private account protected by row-level access controls. Rulebook entries currently remain in your browser.

Process review

When a record is selected, its symbol, side, thesis, invalidation condition, process checks, and aggregate process statistics may be sent to an AI service to create educational feedback. Entry price, exit price, and realized outcome are excluded from that request.

Your choices

You can use the local journal without an account, export your records at any time, clear local browser storage, or sign out to stop cloud synchronization. For data deletion requests, open an issue in the public project repository.

Important limitation

ProcessAlpha is an educational journaling tool. It does not provide financial advice and should not be used as the sole basis for a trade.
